Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a mistake by concluding that General Jean-Baptiste Berthier was the paternal grandfather of Alexandre Berthier, 3rd Prince of Wagram. The information provided by the WebSurfer indicated that Jean-Baptiste Berthier was the grandfather, but it did not specify the paternal relationship. The Planner should have verified this information more thoroughly, as the grandfather mentioned could have been from either the paternal or maternal side. The Planner prematurely concluded the task without ensuring the accuracy of the paternal lineage.
